Container.Name: LibationWeb
Container.Overview:
A web UI wrapper for Libation — the Audible audiobook manager. Connects to your Audible account, scans your library, and downloads audiobooks via LibationCli. Single Docker container with a FastAPI backend and React frontend. Supports multiple users, 2FA, session management, per-user download caps, per-account auto-download, and PUID/PGID for proper Unraid permissions.
Attribution: Built on top of LibationCli by rmcrackan (https://github.com/rmcrackan/Libation). This is an independent community project, not affiliated with the original Libation project.
Container.Description: Web UI wrapper for Libation (Audible audiobook manager). Scan your Audible library and download audiobooks. Supports multiple users, 2FA, per-user download caps, per-account auto-download, and PUID/PGID for Unraid permissions.

Variable.Name: SECRET_KEY
Variable.Description: Used to sign authentication tokens. Use a random string of at least 32 characters — longer is better. Avoid $ and " characters.

Variable.Name: OIDC_ENABLED
Variable.Description: Optional. Set to true to sign in with an OpenID Connect provider (Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak, Pocket ID, and so on). You must also fill in OIDC_ISSUER, OIDC_CLIENT_ID and OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET — until all four are set, password sign-in stays enabled. Once SSO is fully configured, password sign-in switches off; set ALLOW_PASSWORD_LOGIN to true to keep both.

Variable.Name: OIDC_ISSUER
Variable.Description: Optional. Your provider's base URL, e.g. https://auth.example.com — the rest is discovered automatically.

Variable.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
Variable.Description: Optional. The client id you registered with your provider.

Variable.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
Variable.Description: Optional. The client secret you registered with your provider.

Variable.Name: OIDC_REDIRECT_URL
Variable.Description: Optional but required if you reach Libation through a reverse proxy. The exact callback URL registered with your provider, e.g. https://libation.example.com/api/auth/oidc/callback

Variable.Name: ALLOW_PASSWORD_LOGIN
Variable.Description: Optional. Leave blank to let it follow SSO (on until single sign-on is configured, off afterwards). Set to true to keep username/password sign-in available alongside SSO — also how you get back in if your provider is misconfigured.

Variable.Name: DATABASE_URL
Variable.Description: Optional. Leave blank to use SQLite on the /data volume (recommended). To use an existing PostgreSQL server instead, enter a connection string such as postgresql://user:password@host:5432/libation — the schema is created automatically. Switching this points the app at a different, empty database; it does not move your existing data.
